_note: Dutch demo case types (Bezwaar/Beroep/Subsidie) DISABLED for the German-federal English demo. The curated English demo is seeded from lib/Settings/register.d/46-demo-cases-english.json instead. SeedDataService reads `caseTypes`, so this data is parked under `_caseTypes_disabled`. Rename that key back to `caseTypes` to re-enable Dutch seeding (SeedBezwaarBeroepData repair step). The Bezwaar case type moved to register.d/84-woo-bezwaar-case-type.json (woo-case-screens-and-objections REQ-WCS-006). The data is NOT broken and the parking was NOT a mistake: commit 382e953d curated the demo profile on purpose, and un-parking this puts Dutch Bezwaar, Beroep and Subsidie case types next to the four English ones on every fresh install. The setup wizard no longer offers a `seed` step, because CnSetupWizard renders manifest.setup.steps[] verbatim and cannot hide one at runtime, so a step reading this file could only ever answer `422 Nothing to seed`. The `seed` action itself still works over the API and still records `setup_seed_done`, so re-enabling the Dutch profile stays a one-key change plus a manifest step. tests/Unit/Settings/SetupWizardStepsTest.php refuses the step while this key is parked.
